settings.shipping_body:
Orders over $50 ship free within the U.S., and smaller orders show a flat rate at checkout before you pay. You have 14 days from delivery to return it. Start a return from your order email and we send return instructions.

Reviews open after launch. Until then the promise stands on policy: every pick is driven before it goes live, and checkout is secured by Shopify.
